arena.name: KUET campus
arena.subtitle: Khulna University of Engineering and Technology

location.name: Central Library
location.clue: The building full of books and silent readers.
Borrowing is free here, but late returns cost you.
Where knowledge sleeps on shelves until someone wakes it.

location.name: Central Mosque
location.clue: A place of prayer on campus.
A calm place where the day is measured in prayers.
Five times a day, a call from here is heard across campus.

location.name: Medical Center
location.clue: Where sick students get checked by a doctor.
The first stop for fevers, cuts and headaches.
Where a white coat and a prescription pad wait for you.

location.name: Lotus Pond
location.clue: A pond with beautiful flowers floating on it.
Pink petals on still water, a favourite photo spot.
Mud gives birth to a flower here, and everyone stops to look.

location.name: IT Park
location.clue: A technology hub where computers and startups live.
Code, servers and late-night developers work here.
Where ideas turn into software before sunrise.

location.name: Foreign Dormitory
location.clue: A residence for students from other countries.
Guests from far away sleep under this roof.
Many passports, many languages, one corridor.

location.name: Open Stage
location.clue: An open stage for events and performances.
Concerts and cultural shows happen under the open sky here.
No roof, no walls, only a stage and an audience.

location.name: Play Ground
location.clue: A big open field for sports.
Wide open grass where matches begin at sunset.
Eleven players, one ball and a crowd that never sits still.

location.name: Khajar Pond
location.clue: A pond near the trees on campus.
Palm trees stand guard around this water.
Sweet fruit trees watch over the water, and the water watches back.

location.name: IT Pond
location.clue: A pond beside the IT area.
After a long coding session, students come to stare at this water.
Debugging stops here when the screen hurts the eyes.

location.name: Administrative Building
location.clue: Where the university's official papers are handled.
Every certificate and notice begins its journey here.
The desk where a student's fate is stamped and signed.

location.name: Auditorium
location.clue: A big hall with a stage and many seats.
Seminars, cultural nights and convocations happen here.
Where graduates wait for their names to be called.

location.name: Main Gate
location.clue: The entrance of the campus.
Everyone enters through here, nobody ignores it.
The first thing a visitor meets and the last thing they leave behind.

location.name: Shaheed Minar
location.clue: A monument that remembers the language movement.
Flowers are laid here every February.
Bare feet and a sunrise procession on the twenty-first.

location.name: Rokeya Hall
location.clue: The residential hall for girls.
Named after a pioneer of women's education.
A hall named after the woman who dreamed of Sultana's world.

location.name: Academic Buildings
location.clue: Where lectures and classes are held.
Rows of benches, a board and a long morning lecture.
Where attendance is taken and naps are attempted.

location.name: Mechanical Workshop
location.clue: Where engineering students work with machines and tools.
Sparks, metal and the smell of oil.
Theory ends at the door and hands-on learning begins.

location.name: EEE Building
location.clue: The building of the electrical engineering department.
Circuits, current and a lot of wires.
Where students fight with voltage and sometimes lose.

location.name: Civil Extension Building
location.clue: An extra building of the civil engineering department.
Bridges, concrete and structures are studied here.
Future builders of roads and bridges practice their calculations here.

location.name: Architecture Building
location.clue: The building of the architecture department.
Sketches, models and sleepless design nights.
Where students draw tomorrow's buildings on paper today.
